Filters: choose values in the four slicers below. They update every scorecard, chart and segment table on this tab. Anyone with the link can use them without edit access; selections only change your own view.

Churn rate = churned ÷ customers. Retention rate = active ÷ customers. Revenue at risk = monthly charges of churned customers. Average tenure = mean months since sign-up. All figures cover the customers that match the filters (all 15 when nothing is selected).

Payment method: inside Month-to-Month every payment method churned at 100%, and no Bank Transfer customer is on Month-to-Month, so these differences follow the contract mix (see the contract by payment table at the bottom of this tab).
